notes: This contract freezes the identity-binding rules before any concrete observation address is supplied.
The contract does not freeze an account identity while account_address is null.
Hyperliquid account-data queries must use the actual master/subaccount address rather than an agent/API-wallet address.
A later binding change must persist the exact public address, its non-secret provenance, userRole result and userAbstraction result before identity_frozen may become true.

If the supplied account is an agent, vault, missing role, unsupported abstraction mode or otherwise incompatible with PHASE6-LIVE-VALUATION-V1, the correct outcome is BLOCKED_INCOMPATIBLE rather than broadening the contract after observation.
Binding an identity does not arm the collector, configure a schedule, create elapsed credit or authorize production.
